description: Tells the user the baggage allowance for their booking class

utterances: how many bags can I take

nodes.name: AskTravelClass
nodes.text: Which class are you travelling in: economy or business?

nodes.name: ResolveAllowance
BusinessAllowance
nodes.text: Business class: {{context.baggageKg}} kg checked baggage plus 2 cabin bags.

nodes.name: OfferUpgrade
nodes.text: Economy includes {{context.baggageKg}} kg. Would you like to hear about upgrading to business?

nodes.name: UpgradeAgent
nodes.systemContext: You explain the benefits of upgrading from economy to business class using {{context.LookupFare.response.body}}. Be brief.
rules: Never promise a price that is not in the fare data.
exitScenarios: exit when the user is done asking about the upgrade

nodes.name: SummarisePrompt
nodes.prompt: Summarise the baggage allowance ({{context.baggageKg}} kg) in one friendly sentence.

nodes.name: EconomyAllowance
nodes.text: Economy class: {{context.baggageKg}} kg checked baggage plus 1 cabin bag.
